cohort: 1,029,940 nulliparous women with live, singleton, nonanomalous deliveries between 37 and 42 completed weeks of gestation in California
finding: Asian-Indian women had higher odds of cesarean delivery compared to white non-Hispanic women when birth weight exceeded 3,000 g.
mod_finding: Asian-Indian women are at greater risk of Cesarean delivery than white non-Hispanic women, especially when birth weight exceeds 3,000 g.
